plan.notes: Source: official UNI catalog, 'Computer Science, B.S.' sample plan of study (catalog.uni.edu/chas/computerscience/computerscience.pdf), fetched 2026-09-30. Transcription method: manual transcription of the catalog's official Plan of Study Grid (Freshman Fall through Senior Spring, Total Hours: 120). Caveats: (1) Generic slots ('Computer Science Area', 'Computer Science Foundations', 'Computer Science Math Elective', 'Computer Science Specialty', 'Computer Science Elective', 'UNIFI/General Education or University Electives') are modeled as choice:true placeholders; eligible options from the catalog's CS B.S. major requirements. (2) CS Math Elective catalog range is 3-4 hrs; plan uses 3 to hit the 120 total exactly. (3) Catalog year labeled 2025-2026 per the /planofstudy/ catalog verification (2026-09-30); the /chas/ program page does not display a year label. (4) Prerequisites shown only where the catalog sequence implies them (CS 1520 after CS 1510; CS 2530 after CS 1520); other prereq arrays are empty (not inferred).
